review.tagline: Reference repo of Claude Code configuration patterns and guides
review.summary: A documentation-first repository that catalogs Claude Code features (subagents, commands, skills, hooks, MCP, settings, memory) with write-ups and example configs under .claude/. It includes a command-to-agent-to-skill orchestration demo (/weather-orchestrator) and a table comparing community workflows such as Superpowers, Spec Kit and OpenSpec.
review.audience: Claude Code users learning to configure agents, skills, hooks and memory
strengths: Each concept links to a guide page and a matching implemented example in the repo
Working orchestration demo wires a command, an agent and a skill together
Workflow comparison table lists agent, command and skill counts per project
Covers recent Claude Code features such as auto mode, worktrees and agent teams
weaknesses: Reference material only; not an installable plugin or package
Specific to Claude Code; limited use with other coding agents
Many entries link out to external docs and tweets rather than local content
Several listed features are marked beta and may change between releases
